note: California State Parks campground on a coastal bench above Pacific Coast Highway between Corona del Mar and Laguna Beach; the west rows look across the highway to the ocean. All RVs are measured on entry; dry sites take rigs up to 25 ft. No wood or charcoal fires (gas barbecues only). Camp trailer rentals are on site. Tide pools, seven coves and the El Moro backcountry trails. --Claude
summary: Crystal Cove SP Moro (state): parks.ca.gov page + infosheet + Oct 2026 storm releases + ReserveCalifornia API (place, grid, unit details) + gateways.py + Esri. Hookups $75 every night (30/50 A, E/W, 38 ft); dry sites (25 ft) $55, $38.50 winter Sun-Thu, so nightly_low 38.50; Anaheim gateway at 32 km also clears the price gate. 58 sites, year-round, 7-night max. Bayview kept (PCH between, so no on-water value). Phone added.
flags: PRICE GATE: hookup sites are $75 on every night sampled, over US$50. Two things clear it: the dry sites (25-ft limit; a 23-ft rig fits) are $38.50 on Sunday-Thursday nights in winter ($55 otherwise), and gateways.py finds a gateway within 40 km ('Anaheim (metro, 32 km)'). No drop proposed.

FEES: the stored surcharges.weekend 0 holds for the hookup sites but not for dry sites in winter (Fri/Sat $55 vs $38.50 Sun-Thu). The dry-site split is in fees.note; the reviewer may want to clear surcharges.

WATERFRONT: stored 'bayview' kept. Esri: the sites are on a bench inland of Pacific Coast Highway (PCH/Hwy 1 runs between the lowest row and the beach, ~150-250 m to the sand), so no on-water or coastal walk/dunes value is possible. The bench is open toward the sea and the infosheet says 'unparalleled ocean views'. The view is of the open ocean rather than a bay, but bayview is the only marine view value in the vocabulary.

STATUS: the park is 'Open with restrictions' (Historic District swell impacts, 2026-11-26). The Oct 2026 storm releases close the Moro Cove beach south of Lifeguard Headquarters 'until further notice' (bluff crack, Caltrans repair) and the Pelican Point P2 beach access. The campground isn't named as closed and ReserveCalifornia is taking bookings. Worth a caveat if the beach closure persists.
SITES: 58 per the Feb 2025 infosheet (28 hookup + 30 dry); ReserveCalifornia sells 50 (24 + 26), possibly with others held for the on-site trailer rentals. max_rig_ft 38 is the hookup-site limit.
Website unchanged (the parks.ca.gov page and ReserveCalifornia root).
